Supreme Court stays defamation proceedings against Rahul Gandhi

The Supreme Court has granted significant relief to Rahul Gandhi by staying defamation proceedings against him in a case where he had allegedly referred to Prime Minister Narendra Modi as 'Commander-in-thief'. The court's order comes amidst a controversy involving the Election Commission. The stay on the defamation action provides a temporary reprieve for Gandhi.
